date: 2026-09-19
description: "The fourth Danish Workshop on Advanced Molecular Simulation will take place at SDU in Odense on June 3–4, 2027."
categories: [Workshop, Molecular simulation]
---

The **4th Danish Workshop on Advanced Molecular Simulation** will take place on **June 3–4, 2027** at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense.

The meeting will bring together researchers working with molecular simulation across Denmark and beyond, with invited scientific talks, selected contributed talks, hands-on workshops and poster discussions. Further programme and registration information will follow.
